title: Kling 4.0 Goes to Hollywood with Clever AI: AI Video is Moving from a Toy to a Production Line for Enterprises

content_html:
Kling AI has hit the accelerator for its global expansion. On October 14, it will appear at the 2026 Los Angeles Tech Week. What has industry professionals holding their breath is not just the appearance, but a casual preview it dropped — the release of Kling 4.0 is coming soon. The previous version of Kling has already allowed countless creators to pull out cinematic visuals directly from text. Before the release of 4.0, the outside world was most curious about how much effort it had put into motion consistency, instruction following, and long-take storytelling.

This event is not just a simple booth display. Kling AI has brought in Oxen AI and Obsidian Studio as partners. Each side sent one representative to sit at the same roundtable, discussing topics ranging from fundamental model development all the way to platform integration, and then to real-world professional content production. They are trying to answer the same question: when AI video generation is no longer just short videos for showcasing on social media, how can it really get into enterprise products and integrate into daily workflows? For Kling, this is equivalent to taking the issue of whether "video large models can make money and be genuinely used by industries" directly to the stage closest to Hollywood for verification.
